trans-unit.source: What each kind of person may do here. A role carries a privilege level and a set of permissions; system roles ship with the platform and never change.

Two groups of the same precedence set this key, so neither wins. Set it for this hotel, or clear it in one of the groups.
A group or the whole customer reaches every hotel that does not set its own value.
A value. The service that owns the setting decides what it accepts.

What each setting is at this hotel, and where the value comes from: this hotel, one of its groups, the whole customer, or the default. A hotel's own value wins; then the group with the highest precedence; then the customer; then the default.
Every place looked at, in order; the first that sets the key wins.
Value cleared; the next place down applies.
